name: textfresh
description: SHARED TEXT IS NEVER STALE: /tmp/tf is /bin/echo for one run and then, rewritten in place by cp (same inode), /bin/pwd.  The text table keys a program by device, inode and change time, so the second run must load pwd and print the directory; a key without the change time would run echo's cached text again and print an empty line.  The directory name appears only in pwd's output, never in a typed line.
